facts.value: You must have one set of official transcripts from every college and university from which you earned a bachelor's degree or higher sent to ASU. If your school(s) cannot send them directly to ASU, you may send them yourself, making sure they meet one of the following requirements: Original academic credentials issued by the registrar of the institution attended, bearing the original raised or colored seal of the institution and the signature of the institution’s registrar, academic official or recognized international organization; Photocopies of original academic credentials that have been verified as true copies of the original by a responsible official of the institution attended or by an education representative of the country’s government or embassy; or Photocopies of original academic credentials that have been certified by a recognized international educational organization.
Include a certified English translation of all documents not written in English.
For more information about sending transcripts, please visit admission.asu.edu/apply/transcripts.
Any document ASU receives becomes property of ASU and will not be returned to you.
Photocopies certified by a notary public are not official. Scanned copies are also not accepted in lieu of original official academic documents.

All international transcripts must be submitted in their original language accompanied by an official English translation. The translation does not take the place of submitting official academic records in the original language.
Translations must be done by the issuing university or college, an official translation service, Ministry of Education, consulate or embassy, or Education USA.
Current ASU students and alumni do not need to request official transcripts from ASU.
To expedite the processing of your application, please write your application reference number on all documents and envelopes submitted to ASU.
Graduate Admission Services, Arizona State University, 1150 East University Drive Building C, Room 226, Tempe, AZ 85281.
